title: Build a pkgctl command
hints: Start with argv = ["pkgctl", action, package] and append the optional parts with one `if` each, in the order the usage line shows.
Validate action and package at the top and raise ValueError before building anything.
`if timeout is not None` (not `if timeout`) so that timeout=0 still appears; list.extend adds several items at once, and str(timeout) makes the number a string.
extra_args defaults to None, not []; `if extra_args: argv.extend(extra_args)` handles both None and an empty sequence.
